textual.context: The description presents the signup direction and mining statement without an explicit warning, denial, or stated conditions; whether this is promotion or discussion is unclear from the supplied text alone.
textual.potential_relevance: A request to join through the stated signup destination is paired with a claim of easy, low-difficulty creation/mining, which may warrant later assessment of the relationship between the requested signup action and the claimed benefit.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish what the signup process requires, whether any payment or data submission occurs, or whether the mining claim is accurate.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish that the appreciation will occur, the basis for the forecast, transaction terms, or any actual financial outcome.

visual.limitations: The small body text is not fully legible, and these frames do not show a completed purchase, payment recipient, actual returns, or the relationship between the page and the later spreadsheet beyond their chronological appearance.

visual.observation: A spreadsheet lists package tiers including "Starter," "Trader," "Pro Trader," "Executive," "Tycoon," and "Premium," alongside token quantities, euro-denominated price columns, monthly token-price projections, and large projected euro totals; the "Premium" row visibly includes 125000 tokens and a 12500 euro price entry.
visual.context: The spreadsheet is presented as a projection table and visibly states "Disclaimer - Projections ONLY!!!!!!!!!!!!" beneath it.
visual.potential_relevance: The table visibly relates paid package tiers and token quantities to projected values over successive months, which conditionally merits review as a payment-linked return presentation.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish who created the spreadsheet, whether its figures are official or accurate, whether viewers are asked to buy a package, or whether any projected outcome occurred.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes paid OneCoin mining packages, including a €12,500 Premium Trader package, by presenting projected token yields and capital appreciation of up to 860 percent. The speaker encourages participation by describing the package as the most superior option even for new people, while the description directs viewers to join through a signup link. The disclaimer that the figures are projections does not remove the video's active promotion of purchasing the package for mining-linked returns.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S04 fits because viewers are asked to purchase paid mining packages whose value is tied to mining difficulty, token production and projected mining income. S05 is separately evidenced because the promotion also links token acquisition to projected appreciation and percentage gains.
